english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the highest permitted or possible limit.
Use this specifically for the highest permitted amount, level, or number.
Use this for the general upper limit of an object, quantity, or action rather than a physical ceiling.
Use this for an imposed upper limit such as a salary or spending ceiling.

examples.english: The daily withdrawal maximum on this credit card is twenty thousand dollars.
